test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Anne’s eye ______ is very good for someone of her age.
solution: The correct answer is **"sight."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Eye-sight"** refers to the ability to see. (देखने की शक्ति, दृष्टि, नज़र) • **Example**: *She has poor **eyesight**__.* • The sentence is saying that Anne's eyesight is good for someone of her age. • The correct answer is Option 1. **Correct sentence**: *Anne’s eye__**sight**__ is very good for someone of her age. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • "Cite" means to quote or refer to something as evidence or an example. (उदाहरण या प्रमाणस्‍वरूप किसी बात का उल्‍लेख करना या किसी व्‍यक्ति के मूल शब्‍द उद्धृत करना) • **"Side"** refers to one of the edges or surfaces of an object. (किसी वस्‍तु की कोई एक समतल बाहरी सतह; पार्श्व, फ़लक) • **"Site"** refers to a location or place. (वह स्‍थान जहाँ कोई इमारत खड़ी थी, है या होगी; भवन स्‍थल) 190:Taac, The correct answer is **"A. My uncle broke his promise to keep up with the trend of being healthy."**
